# Onefifty

> Onefifty is a brand-activation event hub and pop-rock band from Yogyakarta, Indonesia, formed in 2022 by lecturers and professionals at Universitas AMIKOM Yogyakarta. The primary offer is an exclusive show ("show eksklusif"): Onefifty stages a show just for one brand, designed and filmed for TikTok and Instagram Reels, which is more controlled than joining someone else's event and can be boosted from the brand's own account. As a secondary option, brands can discover public events in Jogja that match their audience and invite Onefifty there. Headline: "Bikin momennya. Hadir di dalamnya." (Create the moment. Be part of it.)

## Exclusive show (primary offer)

- An exclusive Onefifty show for one brand at an agreed location (outlet, cafe, office, campus or community space) and time, with an invited audience such as customers, members or the brand's community.
- Planned for vertical 9:16 content from the start; location, setlist, product placement and filming are decided together, and key moments can be retaken.
- Content is posted from the brand's account or as a collaboration and can be boosted with the brand's own ad budget.
- Format, duration, number of videos and content usage rights are agreed upfront; production is priced separately from the Rp3 million/event starting price for performances.

## Event hub

- Paths besides the exclusive show: (A) pick an upcoming Jogja event from the curated list; (B) "Saya sudah punya event": send a brief for your own event; (C) "Belum tahu event apa": choose target audience, goal and brand category, and the site shows the most relevant events by category and audience (not a promise of results).
- Events are curated from public sources and are not owned by Onefifty. Audience segments and brand fit are Onefifty's own assessment; unknown data (attendance, organizer) is shown as "Belum tersedia" rather than estimated. Presence at an event still requires the organizer's approval; Onefifty helps approach them.
- Activation options: Play (Onefifty performs), Experience (product sampling, vouchers, giveaways), Interact (voting, a brand segment on stage), Share (moments designed to continue as social content).
- The activation builder sends a pre-filled WhatsApp brief: event, brand, goal, chosen activations and budget range.

## Brand collaboration

"KOL membawa brand ke feed. Onefifty membawa brand ke momen." (KOLs bring brands to the feed; Onefifty brings brands into the moment.) Instead of making content for a brand like a KOL/influencer, Onefifty brings the brand into the event itself, where the audience enjoys it together.

- Ways a brand can join: tried (product sampling/experience), played (games, challenges), voted (audience picks songs or options), redeemed (vouchers, promos, rewards), shared (audience-made content), continued (photos, videos, reels and UGC after the event).
- Audiences reached at past events: students, graduating young professionals, creative, technology and academic communities, entrepreneurs/UMKM. Largest recorded: 1,500 new students at Welcome Party 2026.
- Brand categories with a natural fit (opportunities, not past clients): coffee & F&B, bank/fintech/e-wallet, telco, gadgets & laptops, software/SaaS, gaming, education/edtech, fashion, marketplace, logistics, office/productivity, creative industry.

- How it works: the product is present at the event, not just the logo (present); the audience joins through song voting, vouchers, giveaways or trying the product (tried); stage moments continue as photos, videos and clips (shared); votes, vouchers, participants and content can be counted (measurable).
- Pricing: starting from Rp3 million per event. Final price depends on the event and the idea developed together.
- Next opportunity: a nostalgia-themed show bringing songs, games and old memories to one stage.
- Contact: WhatsApp +62 821-3612-3205 (https://wa.me/6282136123205) or Instagram @onefifty.band.

## The name
The name comes from "Asisten Ahli 150", the first academic rank (Jabatan Fungsional Akademik) of an Indonesian lecturer. First rank, first step: that is where the members started playing together.

## Members

- Arif Akbarul Huda: ML/AI Engineer; music producer
- Arifiyanto Hadinegoro: Soft Computing; guitar, bass, drums
- Agit Amrullah: Computer Vision; bass or guitar
- Muhammad Tofa Nurcholis: Game Development; vocals
- Anggit Ferdita Nugraha: Programmer; drums
- Rifda Faticha: UI/UX Researcher; vocals
- Fajar Sigit Purnomo: Computer Network Engineer; bass
- Nadea Cipta Laksmita: AI Music; keyboard, music producer
- Muhammad Najih Fasya: Urban & Regional Planning Researcher; vocals

The lineup is not always the same; it is adjusted to each event.

## Booking and collaboration

Use the event hub on the website, or share the date, venue and an overview of the event via WhatsApp (https://wa.me/6282136123205) or Instagram @onefifty.band (https://www.instagram.com/onefifty.band). Full band or acoustic, from 2 songs up to 3 sessions, with their own monitors.
